maria: Quick sync  benchmark narrative checklist: two hero visuals (cost curve + stability heatmap), 1 social micro-clip, single-page narrative. Keep headline quantifiable and footnoted.
ajay: Chart details: cost-per-1M vs QPS with lines for baseline, quantized, cached+batching. Heatmap = P95 across seq_len x QPS. Call out PLG burst (100-500 rps).
sam: Webinar skeleton: 10m why economics, 15m live bench walk, 10m customer vignette, 10m Q&A. CTA: "Run this benchmark on your workload" -> landing form with expected_monthly_tokens.
jen: Two ad copy tests: A) "Cut inference spend up to 55%" B) "Predictable P95 at burst". We'll run small LinkedIn test.
eli: I'll draft the one-pager and slides. Need cleaned CSV (model,seq_len,tokens/sec,$/1M,p50/p95/p99) from @ajay. Also need % delta table for deck.
ajay: Uploaded CSV to gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/bench-172777. Sample rows included. Small smoke test for docs: curl -s https://api.redwood.com/v1/ping -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' -d '{"model":"rw-opt-8b","seq_len":64}'
maria: Design notes: fixed axis ranges, colorblind-safe palette, annotate where cache/batching kick in (200-800 QPS). Footnote sources.
benchbot: CSV processed and initial chart PNGs available at /marketing/bench/172777_upload. Will ping when final renders are done.
eli: I'll post a draft one-pager tomorrow AM.
maria: Action items: ajay = final CSV + chart renders (Wed AM), eli = one-pager + slides (Wed EOD), jen = social + landing (Thu AM), sam = webinar ops + runbook (Thu EOD). Keep it tight. :rocket:
